summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of new 'Master Armada' admin module. All 8 scenarios in the review request passed: admin login + navigation, 22 seeded rows visible, add/edit/toggle/reorder (persisted after reload)/delete flows, integration with OrderInput armada dropdowns (new active armada appears in both dropdowns, non-active hidden), and role-based access control (operation user has no sidebar entry and is redirected away from /admin/master-armada).
critical_code_review_comments: Reorder up/down data-testid uses raw armada names which can contain spaces/special chars; works today but consider slug/id-based testids for robustness.
Delete uses window.confirm (native) rather than shadcn AlertDialog — functional but inconsistent with the rest of the shadcn UI.
seed_data_creation: Created 'QA INTEGRATION ARMADA' (renamed to EDITED) and 'QA NONACTIVE ARMADA' during test. Both deleted at end of run; verified count=0 for both after delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is via USERNAME field (data-testid='login-username-input', 'login-password-input', 'login-submit-button'). Master Armada page uses data-testid patterns: add-armada-btn, armada-name-input, armada-active-input (checkbox), save-armada-btn, edit-armada-<name>, delete-armada-<name>, armada-toggle-<name>, armada-up-<name>, armada-down-<name>. Reorder persists via backend. OrderInput armada selects: order-armada-requested-input and order-armada-internal-input — both only show active armada. Operation role on /admin/master-armada redirects to '/'.
